evidence: Adds script tracing hooks and exposes them through libbitcoinkernel C and C++ wrapper APIs (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h).
rationale: Exposes an optional script execution tracer through the libbitcoinkernel API to enable external consumers to build script debuggers and analyzers. Multiple reviewers and downstream tools (such as rust-bitcoinkernel and Python visualizers) demonstrate clear demand for intermediate execution state inspection.
